activity.NAME: Applications for Early Voting (By Post) Open
Issue of Writs
activity.DESCRIPTION: Writ(s) are issued by the Governor or the Speaker of the House to proceed with elections.

activity.NAME: Close of Nominations for Registered Parties
activity.DESCRIPTION: Central nominations lodged with the Electoral Commissioner close 24 hours prior to the close of nominations.

activity.NAME: Close of Nominations
activity.DESCRIPTION: Nominations close at 12.00pm and draw for ballot paper positions conducted.

activity.NAME: Close of Rolls
activity.DESCRIPTION: Rolls close at 6.00pm, 8 days after the issue of writ(s).

activity.NAME: Applications for Early Voting (By Post) Close
activity.DESCRIPTION: Applications for early voting (by post) close at 6.00pm.

activity.NAME: Polling Day - Open
activity.DESCRIPTION: Polling is conducted between the hours of 8.00am and 6.00pm.

activity.NAME: Close of Receipt of Postal Votes
activity.DESCRIPTION: Early votes (by post) must be received by the Electoral Commission before 9.00am.

activity.NAME: Deadline for Return of Writs
activity.DESCRIPTION: Last day for the Electoral Commissioner to return the writ(s).
